value.desc: Function to call with the dropped files (identical to description of 'handler' prop of the Object form); Object to also validate the dropped files the way QFile does; false or null (any value that is not a handler, in fact) disables the directive, so the element stops accepting drops until a handler is supplied again
examples: # v-drop-zone="{ handler: myHandler, accept: 'image/*', maxFileSize: 1048576, onRejected: myRejectedHandler }"

files.desc: The dropped File objects; only the first one unless the 'multiple' modifier is set; empty when the drag carried no files

evt.desc: The drop Event; its dataTransfer holds the other payloads of the drag (text, links)

handler.desc: The handler function to be called with the dropped files

files.desc: The dropped File objects that passed the validation; only the first one unless 'multiple' is set; empty when nothing passed or the drag carried no files

evt.desc: The drop Event; its dataTransfer holds the other payloads of the drag (text, links)

multiple.desc: Hand over every dropped file instead of the first one only; takes precedence over the 'multiple' modifier

accept.desc: Comma separated list of unique file type specifiers, the same format as the 'accept' attribute of a native file input

maxFileSize.desc: Maximum size of individual file in bytes

maxTotalSize.desc: Maximum size of all files combined in bytes

maxFiles.desc: Maximum number of files per drop

filter.desc: Custom filter for the dropped files; only the files you return are handed over

activeClass.desc: CSS class to apply to the element while a drag hovers it, instead of the default 'q-drop-zone--over'

onRejected.desc: Called after a drop when some files do not pass the validation (accept, maxFileSize, maxTotalSize, maxFiles, filter)

rejectedEntries.desc: Array of { failedPropValidation: string, file: File } Objects for files that do not pass the validation

multiple.desc: Hand over every dropped file instead of the first one only
